why_one_thread: Without torch.set_num_threads(1) workers contend and the contention is charged against per-decision wall-clock budgets. In c019 that inverted rankings: a harmful search measured 0.605 under load against 0.111 sequentially.
serialization_policy: All latency-bounded MCGS runs execute in ONE serialized queue; nothing runs concurrently with them.
memory_note: Rollout states are released as the rollout advances. Holding them to the end of a decision measured 1.2-1.3 GB per worker and 28.6 GB resident, and 4 games did not finish in 14 minutes; after the fix the same 4 games took 14.7 s.
